name: Construction-Computing Education Topic Vocabulary
description: Controlled vocabulary for the `topics` field, organised into two facets: computing/digital topics (the subject of this map) and domains/disciplines (the built-environment context in which they are taught). Each record's `topics` are also split into `computingTopics` and `domains`. New dataset entries should use these controlled terms only.

computingTopics.definition: Digital and computational methods, tools, standards and technologies for the built environment — the core subject of this map.

domains.definition: Built-environment disciplines, application domains and management areas that provide the context for the computing topics.
